title: One workspace. All your drives.
summary: The first release of Cirro brings your Google Drive accounts into one desktop workspace, with a personal Home, offline access and folder sync built for Windows.

items.title: Up to five Google accounts
items.description: Sign in with Google and switch between individual accounts and All accounts. Search across connected drives, give accounts labels and colours, and see their combined storage usage.

items.title: A personal Home for every view
items.description: Keep a separate Home layout for each account and Unified view. Pin files and folders, choose widgets, and arrange storage, file composition, recent files, activity and sync information.

items.title: A familiar file manager
items.description: Browse My Drive, Shared with me, Starred, Recent, Trash and Storage. Use breadcrumbs, back, forward and up navigation, list or grid views, sorting, pagination and checkbox selection for bulk actions.

items.title: Search and sidebar shortcuts
items.description: Search file names, account labels and folder paths, including quoted phrases and type:, account: and in: filters. Pin shortcuts to the sidebar and customize navigation order, visibility, spacing and width.

items.title: Quick Look and file details
items.description: Single-click to inspect details, double-click to open, or press Space for a separate preview. View supported images, PDFs, audio, video, text, code, archive listings and document formats. Open in Drive is available when you need the web viewer.

items.title: File and folder actions
items.description: Upload files or entire folder trees, create folders with a chosen colour and icon, rename, star, move, copy, trash and restore. Destination pickers support folders within an account and transfers between connected accounts, subject to Google permissions.

items.title: Sharing controls
items.description: Review people with access, manage supported viewer and editor permissions, and create viewer links where Google allows it. Owner and inherited permissions remain protected.

items.title: Offline files and folders
items.description: Save individual files or whole folders to a location you choose for each account. Open saved copies and use them for previews, review missing or outdated downloads, and remove offline copies separately from Drive files.

items.title: Cirro Flow folder sync
items.description: Connect a local folder to a destination under My Drive / Cirro. Sync changes in both directions while Cirro runs, pause or resume a folder, review recovery copies, and keep both versions when conflicts occur.

items.title: Cirro Cloud preview
items.description: Create a Windows File Explorer cloud view with placeholders and download-on-demand. Choose its account and folder, review the preview warning, and remove the view when you no longer need it.

items.title: Persistent transfer management
items.description: Follow upload, download, move and copy progress. Pause, cancel and retry supported transfers, with queued work saved on this device for recovery after a connection loss or restart. Enable Transfers in sidebar customization when you want a permanent shortcut.

items.title: Windows desktop integration
items.description: Choose launch at login, start minimized, restore the last location and keep running in the tray. Receive Cirro-branded upload, transfer-error and storage notifications with relevant actions, plus controls for sound and Do not disturb.

items.title: Appearance and first-run guide
items.description: Choose Light, Dark or System appearance, five accent colours, reduced motion and reduced transparency. The first-run guide uses optional practice examples, so it works before you connect an account or add files.

items.title: Local storage and support
items.description: See a horizontal breakdown of database, offline, upload-staging and recovery storage. Clear cached thumbnails or finished transfers, reclaim database space, rebuild metadata, run local diagnostics and request Google test-account access.

items.title: Faster browsing with local metadata
items.description: Account-scoped SQLite caching stores file metadata, folder structure, thumbnails and preferences. File content is fetched when requested, explicitly saved offline or staged for a transfer.

items.title: Clearer progress and storage
items.description: Themed progress bars and bottom-right operation indicators keep background work visible. Cloud storage uses account-coloured segments; local storage separates Cirro data from available disk space.

items.title: Settings built around clear tasks
items.description: Grouped panels, custom dropdowns and expandable sections, searchable controls, keyboard navigation and consistent spacing make preferences easier to find and change.

items.title: Drive views and permissions
items.description: My Drive browsing follows folder structure instead of flattening every descendant into the root. Sharing listings recover from expired page tokens, and file actions respect the owning account and Google permissions.

items.title: Preview and selection feedback
items.description: Unavailable previews and size limits appear inside Quick Look. Inspecting an item stays separate from checkbox selection, and previews offer a route back to Google Drive.

items.title: Window layout and readable values
items.description: Window sizing respects the Windows work area. Storage figures, percentages and modified dates use readable formatting, with themed controls throughout the interface.

items.title: Windows Hello app lock
items.description: Require Windows Hello to open or return to Cirro, choose an inactivity timeout, and lock immediately. App lock gates access through Cirro; it does not encrypt offline files or prevent access through File Explorer.

items.title: Account credentials and history
items.description: Saved Google sessions use the operating system credential store. Choose whether Cirro remembers recently opened files and sign out individual accounts in Settings.

items.title: Private diagnostics
items.description: Diagnostic reports exclude account identities, file names, local paths, tokens and file contents. Review, copy or save a report yourself; nothing is sent automatically.

items.title: Verified application updates
items.description: Cirro checks for updates at launch and hourly while running. Update downloads are signature-verified, show progress without interrupting your work, and wait for your restart choice.

items.title: Windows and Google access
items.description: This release targets Windows. Google ownership, sharing permissions and storage limits still apply. While Cirro’s OAuth app is in testing, accounts must be approved before connecting.

items.title: Offline and sync requirements
items.description: Cirro must be running for background transfers and sync. Google editor documents and shortcuts remain online or use supported exports and links; local changes to an ordinary offline copy do not upload automatically. Use Flow for two-way folder sync.

items.title: Cloud views are a preview
items.description: Cirro Cloud provides read-only snapshot views, not a writable virtual drive. Review its warning before enabling it. Flow does not support links, junctions or other providers’ cloud placeholders.

items.title: Transfers and recovery
items.description: An interrupted individual file may restart from the beginning. Cross-account copies of Google-native documents require destination-account access. Cancelling a transfer keeps files already copied, and recovery copies require review rather than automatic deletion.
